business.description: Jain Marmo Industries Limited is a manufacturer, exporter, and importer of marble blocks, slabs, and tiles, including Green Marble, White Marble, Rainforest Green Marble, and Granites. The company operates quarries and a processing factory in Udaipur, Rajasthan.

products.name: Green Marble
products.note: One of the largest producers and processors of Green Serpentine Marble Blocks and Slabs

products.note: Imported from Italy, Turkey, Spain, China, Iran etc.

products.note: Domestic sales Rs 61.36 crore, Export sales Rs 2.42 crore in FY2025-26

outlook.statement: Management views the decline in sales as a short term blip and is optimistic of growth at a faster rate in the years to come looking to the buoyancy in market sentiments and attractive real estate prices.

Directors are optimistic that demand for imported marble and Indian marbles would show incremental growth based on inquiries generated and government seriousness for development of housing and infrastructure industry.
Management is fully equipped to take the opportunity of any upsurge in demand and capturing a major share of the incremental market demand.

The Management however views this phenomenon as a short term blip and is optimistic of growth at a faster rate in the years to come looking to the buoyancy in the market sentiments and attractive real estate prices.
The industry is expected to achieve average annual growth and many new players are expected to be stepping into the industry.
